Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators.

With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level 

• High level of reading and writing technical English is a must 

• High level of computer literacy will be required for daily tasks 

• Have the ability to work within a small team and act independently when required 

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

We are looking for a Corporate Accounting Expert to strengthen a finance team in Groot-Bijgaarden. In this role, you will support the Accounting Manager and contribute to the quality, accuracy and timely delivery of accounting and financial reporting activities. You will also act as a point of reference for the accounting team and support colleagues with complex or non-routine matters.

Your responsibilities:

• Coordinate the administration related to invoices and commitments, including leasing, housekeeping, payroll, real estate taxes and travel expenses.
• Monitor relevant expenditures against budget and follow up with external parties such as suppliers, municipalities and surveyors when required.
• Coordinate the external audit process and prepare or review audit documentation and samples.
• Review account reconciliations, including accruals, prepayments and suspense accounts, as well as payroll reconciliations in cooperation with the Payroll Manager.
• Contribute to month-end closing and management reporting by analysing account movements and explaining significant fluctuations.
• Ensure accurate intercompany accounting and recharges.
• Coordinate VAT, real estate tax and other relevant tax compliance activities together with the Tax department.
• Support budgeting activities and the preparation and review of statutory accounts.
• Contribute to financial reporting for subsidiaries in line with IFRS and local GAAP.
• Support accounting activities related to mergers, acquisitions and entity integrations.
• Coordinate local GAAP accounting memos where required.
• Ensure appropriate accounting procedures, controls and systems are implemented and followed.
• Participate in European finance projects, including system implementations, entity integrations, IFRS migrations and updates to policies and procedures.
• Contribute to process improvements and other ad-hoc finance projects.
• Support the Accounting Manager in guiding the Corporate Accounting team and provide advice on non-routine accounting matters.
• Help onboard and train new and existing team members.

Your profile:

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Accounting, Finance, Economics or equivalent professional experience.
• At least 5 years of accounting experience.
• Solid experience preparing financial statements.
• Experience within a services or retail environment.
• Strong knowledge of IFRS and local GAAP.
• Experience with CRM/ERP migration or upgrade projects, particularly UAT, key-user or training responsibilities.
• SAP experience is required; knowledge of SAP S/4HANA is an advantage.
• Experience in a multi-country or shared-services environment is a plus.
• Previous management experience is an advantage.
• Fluent in English and French. German is considered a strong asset, while additional market languages are a plus.
• Good knowledge of Microsoft applications and advanced Excel skills.

What you will do
 
 

• Operate and monitor high-tech automated machines to ensure uninterrupted production. 

• Maintain accurate performance and efficiency of the tools as qualified user. 

• Follow and understand procedures, instructions and WoW quickly and apply them correctly. 

• Able to act correctly and clearly under pressure and ask support when needed.  

• Quickly identify and report any issues or malfunctions to First Line Support (FLS) or WIP lead. 

• Follow safety and operational procedures to maintain a secure and efficient work environment. 

• Communicate in clear language and understandable terms (also in English) and participate actively in shift handover.  

• Keep everything tidy according to 5S rules. 

• Refill chemicals. 

Who you are
 
 

• Experience in operations environment or a similar field is preferred, but we focus on potential. 

• Strong organizational and multitasking skills. 

• Ability to work independently and prioritize tasks effectively. 

• Good communication and teamwork skills. 

• Proactive, detail-oriented and dynamic. 

• Knowledge of English  

Below is an example of the shift schedule, providing a clear understanding of the work hours and rotation you can expect in this role:
 
 

• Week X: You will work the early shift (06:15 – 14:15) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+1: You work the night shift (21:45 – 06:30) from Monday to Friday. 

• Week X+2: You work the late shift (14:00 – 22:00) from Monday to Wednesday, on Thursday and Friday you have recuperation and on Saturday and Sunday you work 12h - (06:30 – 18:30)  

• Week X+3: From Monday to Wednesday, you have recuperation and on Thursday and Friday you work in the late shift (14:00 – 22:00). 

• Week X: You work from Monday to Friday in the early shift. (06:15 – 14:15).

Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - Major Migration Programme - Brussels

Are you an experienced SAP S/4HANA specialist looking to play a key advisory role in a major transformation project?

We are partnering with a leading organisation in the Belgian financial services sector undertaking a strategic SAP ECC to S/4HANA Brownfield migration.

This is an opportunity to support the transformation of Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable and Business Partner processes while working closely with internal business and master data teams.

As a trusted functional expert, you will help stakeholders understand SAP standard functionalities, evaluate available solutions and ensure a smooth transition towards S/4HANA.
Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - The Job
You will:

• Advise business teams on SAP S/4HANA Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Business Partner and Customer Vendor Integration (CVI).
• Assess differences between ECC and S/4HANA, recommend standard solutions and evaluate impacts on master data and P2P/O2C processes.
• Support business stakeholders through functional guidance, knowledge transfer, testing activities and validation of implementation partner recommendations.
Senior SAP S/4HANA AP/AR & Business Partner Expert - Your Profile
You have:

• Strong functional expertise in SAP FI-AP, FI-AR, Business Partner and CVI, including customer and supplier master data.
• Proven experience with SAP S/4HANA, ideally involving ECC to S/4HANA migrations and integration with MM/SD processes.
• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to explain complex SAP functionalities to non-technical business stakeholders.
Fluent English is required; Dutch is a strong advantage.
